title: Career Roadmap: Consultant
summary: Help organizations identify problems, evaluate opportunities, analyse information and develop practical recommendations to improve business performance, operations, strategy or social impact.

facts.Current degree: Liberal Arts / Liberal Studies (BA / B.Sc Liberal Arts & Sciences)

about.label: Education Pathway
about.text: Liberal Arts / Liberal Studies – Liberal Arts & Sciences (Major-Minor Flexible)

blocks.text: Help organizations identify problems, evaluate opportunities, analyse information and develop practical recommendations to improve business performance, operations, strategy or social impact.

rows.text: Any stream; develop analytical, communication and problem-solving skills
Liberal Arts & Sciences with a major in Economics, Psychology, Political Science, Sociology, Business or Data Analytics
Strategy, management, human resources, public policy, market research or social impact
MBA, Master's in Public Policy, Economics, Psychology or another relevant specialization, depending on the consulting field

blocks.label: Important
blocks.text: A liberal arts degree can provide a strong foundation for consulting. However, specialist consulting roles may require relevant technical qualifications, industry experience or professional credentials.

blocks.label: Problem-Solving
blocks.text: Break complex problems into manageable questions and test assumptions.

blocks.label: Research & Analysis
blocks.text: Collect evidence, analyse qualitative and quantitative information, and draw conclusions.

blocks.label: Business Understanding
blocks.text: Learn business models, operations, market dynamics and performance metrics.

blocks.label: Communication
blocks.text: Prepare reports, presentations, executive summaries and client recommendations.

blocks.label: Data Tools
blocks.text: Excel, PowerPoint, basic SQL and Power BI or Tableau.

blocks.label: Client Management
blocks.text: Stakeholder interviews, teamwork, meeting management and professional conduct.
Develop three or four consulting-style case studies:

blocks.label: Business Case
blocks.text: Identify why a fictional company is losing customers and recommend improvements.

blocks.label: Market Research
blocks.text: Assess demand, competitors and customer segments for a proposed product.

blocks.label: Process Improvement
blocks.text: Map a workflow and suggest measurable efficiency improvements.

blocks.label: Social Impact Study
blocks.text: Analyse a community or public-service problem and propose an evidence-based intervention.

blocks.label: Strategy Presentation
blocks.text: Summarize the problem, analysis, options, risks and recommendations in a concise slide deck.
Clearly distinguish assumptions from verified facts and support recommendations with evidence.
Target placements at:

items.text: Corporate strategy, operations and business transformation teams.

blocks.text: Search for Consulting Intern, Business Analyst Intern, Research Analyst Intern, Strategy Intern and Management Trainee positions.
Useful areas include:

items.text: Consulting problem-solving and case interview preparation.
SQL, Power BI or Tableau for analytical consulting.

blocks.text: Certifications are supplementary; strong case studies, internships and communication skills provide practical evidence of readiness.
Consulting / Research Intern
Analyst / Associate Consultant
Consultant / Senior Consultant
Manager → Principal / Partner
Titles vary by firm and specialization. Independent consulting is another option after developing relevant expertise and a client network.

rows.text: Explore consulting specializations and learn structured problem-solving, Excel and presentation fundamentals.
Complete two consulting case studies and create a concise recommendation presentation.
Practise case interviews, improve the résumé and apply for internships and entry-level analyst roles.

blocks.label: Target-ready profile
blocks.text: Structured problem-solving, research and analytical ability, clear business communication, presentation skills and a portfolio demonstrating practical recommendations.
